title: Iron Rain Formation
description: Oath Under Thunder: Iron Rain Formation unfolds across storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian squad to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Iron Rain Formation advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span

objectives.primary: Claim two oath-stones before the storm breaks formation.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks

specialRules: Oathbound Guard: Titans that survive damage near oath-stones empower their next committed strike.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
victoryConditions: Claim two oath-stones before the storm breaks formation.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.

recommendedTitans.name: Eirwyn Valkstorm
recommendedTitans.reason: Breaker advantage for heavily armored enemies

recommendedTitans.reason: Guardian advantage for heavily armored enemies
